limitations: Ideal infinite-span 2D pressure is Pa, not Pa/m; loading is N/m.
2D WALE / LES-model calculation, not resolved 3D turbulence or broadband prediction.
Body and permeable are overlapping alternatives: never sum them or call their difference a quadrupole.
Viscous traction and exterior volume quadrupoles omitted; zero acoustic propagation mean flow.
Finite Hann-window coherent-gain coefficients and selected-band synthesis; not PSD, full sound or causal arrivals.
Startup exclusion is not demonstrated stationarity; no mesh/time/bandwidth convergence or experimental validation.

public_view_changes: Omitted unused comparisons field: inherited physical_interpretation_allowed denotes matched native support, not physical validation.
Directivity description corrected to sparse unconnected markers; arrays, bins, clocks, windows and units unchanged.
Added exact native media and full numerical downloads; replaced private analysis JSON with public allowlisted verification.
